comparison.objective: Tune and lock a shock absorber vs seat a hot-swap drive carrier using its cam handle.
comparison.physical_skill: Recessed key insertion, collar tuning, counterholding, and relocking vs guided carrier insertion and cam-handle levering/latching.
comparison.success_condition: Two safe impact cycles plus setting retention vs insertion depth, handle angle, latch state, and bay/carrier damage limits.
comparison.reason: Both include a retained final state, but the record tests insertion and cam latching rather than iterative damper commissioning.
